statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope attributed to sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Diagnosis codes I49.5 and G45.9 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The service does not meet specific medical necessity criteria outlined in the coverage policy
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
